_description: BPGV_ROTATION_PORTFOLIO - Macro regime rotation strategy using building permit growth volatility

config._comment_crash_disabled: A1 build: the crash override is RETIRED — the alpha-attribution analysis (docs/bpgv_alpha_attribution_analysis.md) showed it destroyed ~130pp of return over 2011-2026. crash_threshold=-0.99 plus crash_override.trigger.method=fixed_drawdown makes the trigger unreachable; the crash_override block is kept inert for code-path compatibility.
config._comment_cash: Remediation Fix 1: BIL and DBMF live in a cash bucket with zero base weight in normal regimes. They only accumulate weight during crash override and serve as TSM risk-free reference.

crash_override._comment_basket: Tier-1 Change 1: cash + bonds + gold + managed futures. SPY is NOT in the defensive basket (baseline bug: SPY was 32% and the single largest realized loser).

trigger._comment: A1 build: method=fixed_drawdown + crash_threshold=-0.99 (above) makes the crash override unreachable — retired per the alpha-attribution analysis. The volatility_scaled params below are kept for reference only.

exit._comment: Change 4: signal-contingent exit. 5-day min hold, 5-day confirmation window, composite score > 0.55.

rebalance._comment: Tier-2: monthly_only mode available (code-path guarded) but disabled in active config — produced negative targets under the portfolio executor's establishment path. Using wide tolerance bands from remediation.

momentum._comment: Tier-2 W3 reverted — worse performance when combined with W2.

breakout._comment: Tier-2 W2 reverted — worse performance when combined with W3.

config._comment_vol_target: A1 deep-analysis follow-on (May 2026). Portfolio-level realized-vol scalar applied after normalize_weights; sum(weights) ≤ 1.0 by design, residual stays as cash. Frictionless Python replay (tools/analysis/a1_candidate_screen.py::c3_vol_target) at 10% target produced Sharpe 0.918 (vs A1 0.815), fit 0.877 / hold 0.959, 2022 cal return −19.9% vs A1 −26.8%, max DD −24.3% vs A1 −32.5%. Moreira-Muir 2017, Harvey et al. 2018.
config._comment_defensive_sleeve: A1 deep-analysis follow-on (May 2026). Addresses the 2022 hedge failure documented in reports/a1_drawdown_autopsy.md — TLT lost −19.6% and GLD −8.0% during Aug-Oct 2022 while held at ≈45% each (TLT alone was the single largest dollar loser of the entire run, −$38,903). Mechanism: inverse-vol re-allocate within {TLT, GLD}, then if σ_joint > pair_vol_target, scale the pair down and route the slack to BIL.
